contradicting_evidence: Current breadth contraction, negative settled ETF flows and declining stablecoin supply provide a coherent downside tilt that could persist into the week.
Conversely, limited ETH relative strength, near-flat hourly prices and fearful sentiment leave a rebound path open, although none confirms durable recovery.
The supplied evidence does not demonstrate that either the current contraction or the tentative stabilization will persist for seven days.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A renewed decline, an unsuccessful stabilization attempt, and a retest followed by repair remain unresolved alternatives. Current conditions are fragile, but there is insufficient evidence to select a reliable seven-day net direction or turning window. Any BTC or ETH rebound would still require separate confirmation of altcoin participation.
falsification_conditions: A sustained sequence of improving prices, persistent ETH/BTC strength, broad participation and improving capital-flow evidence would replace NO_EDGE with an upward directional case.
Persistent fresh price declines accompanied by continued breadth contraction and renewed negative flow observations would establish a stronger downward directional case.
missing_evidence: No multi-session price and participation sequence establishes a durable regime transition or persistent continuation.
No subsequent settled ETF sessions, stablecoin-supply trajectory or confirmed deployment evidence resolves the weekly liquidity outlook.
No source-qualified catalyst path or verified broad-alt and microcap transmission evidence supports a weekly turning point.
supporting_evidence: The strongest evidence describes existing contraction; it does not establish how long that contraction will last or when recovery would begin.
Short-window stabilization conflicts with weak broader participation, leaving the transition from selling pressure to durable repair unproven.
There is no confirmed broad-alt rotation or established stablecoin deployment that would justify extrapolating a major-coin rebound into a market-wide weekly recovery.
